# Cully v0.8.1

Codex metric rows now sit next to each other, with one blank row after section titles and between major sections. The three-column gaps stay unchanged, and both prioritized advisor previews remain visible. Short terminals trim optional whitespace before metrics.

`cully codex resume` automatically loads the selected thread's saved model, context, token/quota instruments, verification state and tool/MCP counters, then continues accumulating new activity. An explicit native thread ID restores the first frame before the child opens; the interactive picker restores its selected thread through SessionStart. Native cumulative token totals replace saved totals without double counting.

Opening a thread also starts a bounded, read-only Cully MCP connection check through the coding agent's existing configuration and identity. Actual response hooks update health/authentication; worker text alone cannot establish health. Probe calls do not increase foreground tool or MCP totals, and closing the pane prevents late probes from changing the saved state.

Validation: Go formatting, vet and the full race suite; reduced-spacing bounds, explicit-ID resume parsing, persisted metrics, probe response/authentication fixtures, closed-session guards and worker-output evidence checks.
